description: What energy infrastructure to support 1.5°C scenarios? - Scenario data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Igor Arduin (Artelys). This excel file summarizes the main assumptions considered for the analysis " What energy infrastructure to support 1.5°C scenarios?", prepared by Artelys on behalf of the European Climate Foundation in 2020. The report is available here: https://www.artelys.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/Artelys-2050EnergyInfrastructureNeeds.pdf. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
